title: Book Three · Chapter 185: The First Thirty
story:
Ronan's first full working week begins on the first Monday in January.

He spends the mornings between the counter and the paper table. After lunch, he writes short replies from Mr Sun's checked notes.

On Friday, a man asks about a small box for a present. He needs it the next day.

Ronan shows him the finished boxes. The man likes one but wants a darker top.

“Can you change it today?” he asks.

Ronan checks with Mr Sun. A new top would need more time. Mr Sun gives him the earliest possible date.

Ronan brings that answer back. The man looks disappointed.

“Tomorrow is the birthday.”

Ronan looks at the finished boxes again. Another has a darker top, but it is a little larger.

“Would you like to see this one?”

Ronan sets the larger box on the counter. He leaves the smaller one beside it.

The man puts a hand on each lid.

“This one looks better,” he says, touching the smaller box.

Ronan waits. He wants the man to take the larger one. It is ready, and the dark top is right. But the man keeps looking at the smaller shape.

“What needs to go inside?” Ronan asks.

“A little book. And some cards from the children.”

“All together?”

“Yes. My wife keeps them.”

Ronan opens both boxes. He puts the lids behind them so the man can see the space.

“You can try your things in here.”

“I only have one card with me.”

“That can help.”

Ronan moves the wrapping paper away from the counter. He does not begin to wrap either box. The man reaches into his coat, and Ronan gives him room to try.

The man tries the lid and looks at the inside. He takes a small envelope from his coat and puts it in the larger box. The card inside it can lie flat. Then he smiles.

“This will hold the cards too.”

Mr Sun checks the choice and takes the payment. Ronan wraps the box with its lid closed. The man writes a name on his own gift card before he leaves.

Afterward, Ronan puts the first box back in its place.

“He found one,” the counter helper says.

“A larger present.”

She laughs and clears the space for the next customer.

At four, Mr Sun checks the five work dates and pays Ronan thirty yuan.

Ronan counts it before he puts it in his bag. At home, the first thirty joins his old sixty-nine. His work envelope now holds ninety-nine yuan.

Mum looks at the thicker envelope while she puts away her own customer book.

“A full week.”

“My feet know.”

She smiles and moves a stool toward him. He sits for a few minutes before he changes his shirt.

Dad comes home later. He asks about the gift box, and Ronan shows its shape with his hands.

“A different one solved the problem,” he says.

“And the right date,” Dad answers.

Ronan nods. He puts the work envelope away and takes out his phrase book for a short practice.

At dinner, Mum gives him the larger of two bowls. He looks at it, then at her.

“A larger present?”

She laughs. Dad asks for the other bowl, and Ronan passes it over before he begins his meal.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

disappointed＝失望的；earliest＝最早的；choice＝选定的东西、选择；thicker＝更厚的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样处理“明天就要、又想改盒盖”的真实需要？他有没有乱许交期？
2. 首周实际上了多少工作日、领多少钱？工资信封现在多少？

## 读句子

**My feet know.**

拆开看：My feet / know.

我的双脚／最能感受到这一整周的忙碌。
